verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an IP office's online services, such as batch filing or bulk register queries, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes single-application filing routes (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAdirektPro, paper) and search databases. The DPMAdirektWeb 'shopping cart' covers picking goods and services within one trade mark application, not acting on many items at once, so nothing evidences bulk or batch operations.
